statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Residual post-FOMC repricing remains active, but the completed cash session showed substantial two-way reversal rather than an uninterrupted Nasdaq decline.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The main near-term checkpoints are overnight rates-sensitive repricing and Thursday's 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster.
headline: Post-FOMC Tail eases to WATCH as the Nasdaq closes nearly flat despite higher yields
body: The Fed raised the target range to 3.75%-4.00%. The cash session reversed sharply after the decision, yet the Nasdaq finished nearly unchanged while the Dow and S&P 500 closed lower and Treasury yields rose. Oil fell, reducing one cross-asset amplifier. Fresh post-reopen Globex NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so Tail is 22% rather than an elevated block.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 published hourly assessments were mostly low Tail before the FOMC, rose to WATCH around the decision, briefly reached 25% elevated during the late-session reversal, and then eased back to WATCH as the Nasdaq closed nearly flat.
outlookSummary: Residual post-FOMC Tail is expected to decay overnight if price discovery remains two-way. Conditional Tail rises again into Thursday's 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and the cash open, without assuming that the releases will produce a one-way move.

forecast.analysis: The cash session completed a large two-way post-FOMC reversal: the Nasdaq finished nearly flat while broader indexes fell and Treasury yields rose. Fresh Globex NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so Tail stays in WATCH rather than elevated.
drivers: Post-FOMC cash reversal left Nasdaq nearly flat
